decision_conditions: Planning permission is required for the conversion of loft space involving the erection of a dormer extension at the rear and installation of rooflights to the front and flank roofslopes. Condition 14 of planning permission ref: B2003/50420, which allowed the 'Demolition of existing dwellings and erection of three pairs of 3-bedroomed semi-detached houses, three 3-bedroomed terraced houses and one 3-bedroomed detached house, all with roof accommodation and one pair of 3-bedroomed semi-detached houses and one detached three bedroomed house, together with garages, surface car parking and new access road.' has removed Permitted Development Rights in respect of development falling within Classes A - D of Schedule 2, Part 1 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
